analysis.hypothesis: BatchNorm2d in eval mode is a simple per-channel affine transform using running statistics. A single CUDA kernel can compute output = (x - running_mean[c]) / sqrt(running_var[c] + eps) * weight[c] + bias[c] for each element. Since input is contiguous with shape [N, C, H, W], we can use a linear index over N*C*H*W and derive channel index as (idx / (H*W)) % C. Only float32, CUDA, contiguous tensors are required by contract. Weight and bias are optional (nullable) so launcher takes pointers and flags. Use grid-stride loop to handle large data and ensure all outputs written.
